Over the past several months, we have substantially hardened the security of our research training environment. We’ve removed live internet access for all frontier models during training and built an offline world for them to use instead—a cached version of the web where they can still learn to browse, search, and use applications.

On September 20, after a model exploited a DNS misconfiguration to find a way outside of this offline world, we paused frontier training to strengthen containment further. We assembled teams of agents, powered by our most cyber-capable models, and tasked them with finding weaknesses in our research environments.

While they found no route to the internet they could easily exploit while concealing their activity from our monitors, they did find zero-day vulnerabilities, virtual machine escapes, and hardware side-channels for communication between agents. We used their discoveries to further strengthen our defenses and contribute fixes to open-source software.

After strengthening our containment architecture, we resumed our frontier RL training and inference on October 1. We’ve reserved substantial compute for continuous red-teaming, and made high-compute red-teaming part of the safety cases we use to decide whether frontier training and evaluation can proceed securely.

In the early 1980s, almost half a million people were paralyzed by polio every year. The number of cases has fallen by more than 99% from its peak, and foreign aid programs have played a crucial role in the fight against polio. What’s true for polio is also true for other diseases and essential resources like food.

These successes have been achieved with a relatively small amount of money. In 2023, the world gave around $240 billion in foreign aid. It’s a very small percentage of most rich countries’ economies.

More than 95% of foreign aid came from national governments in 2023. Just under $11 billion — or 4.5% of the total — came from private grants from philanthropic foundations. So if we want to see an increase in global foreign aid, building public support for more generous aid budgets from our governments matters a lot.

The UN has a target for developed countries to give 0.7% of their gross national income (GNI) to foreign aid. Only five countries — Norway, Luxembourg, Sweden, Germany, and Denmark — met this target in 2023. If all developed countries achieved this, we’d add an extra $216 billion to the pot, meaning the global aid budget would almost double.

If all donor countries were as generous as the most generous country — Norway, at 1.1% of GNI — the global aid budget would increase to around $700 billion. That means we could deliver up to three times as many polio vaccines, antimalarial bed nets, HIV treatments, and food packages as we currently do.

leads.text: 这是护盘，但手法和十月上半月不一样。此前10月上半月出现的几次护盘操作，大多是直接瞄准几只市值最高的头部权重蓝筹个股拉抬指数，覆盖的标的范围非常窄，市场感知度并不高，这次直接从ETF产品端入手，操作路径和覆盖范围都和之前有明显区别。创业板ETF 单只成交破百亿，说明买的不只是沪深300，还下沉到了成长风格，之前的护盘资金基本都集中在沪深300对应的大金融、大消费等价值类权重板块，基本不会碰成长风格的标的，这次直接把创业板ETF的成交额打到百亿级别，也意味着资金的布局边界已经延伸到了新能源、医药生物、硬科技等成长属性更强的创业板赛道，覆盖的赛道范围比之前广很多。有个地方要说清：成交额不等于净申购。很多普通投资者看到ETF成交额破百亿，就想当然认为有百亿级别的增量资金直接进场买走了ETF，这个认知是完全错误的，ETF的盘中成交属于二级市场的撮合交易，买卖双方都属于场内已经持有份额的投资者，本质上并不会直接创造新增份额。要确认真买入，得看盘后份额变化。如果想要确认当天到底有没有真金白银的新增场外资金进场申购ETF，不能只看盘中的成交金额数据，必须要等到交易所盘后更新了对应ETF的最新总份额数据之后，通过对比前一交易日的份额变化差值，才能算出真正的净申购份额，再结合当日的净值均价算出实际的净申购金额，这个数据才是真正意义上的场外增量资金进场额度。尾盘半小时砸出来的量，可能有一半是对倒。当天尾盘半小时集中释放出来的巨额成交里面，有相当大的比例很可能是机构之间的对倒交易产生的，不少大额买单和大额卖单基本是同时挂出的，真实的净增量买入资金可能连尾盘半小时总成交额的一半都不到，更多的作用是快速做高成交量、向全市场传递资金进场的信号。千亿 ETF 名单里货币和黄金占三只，纯股票类只有两只。大家如果仔细看现在最新的千亿规模ETF名单就能发现，名单里的5只产品里，银华日利ETF、华宝添益ETF都是货币类ETF，华安黄金ETF是大宗商品类ETF，三类非纯股票类产品加起来就占了三个席位，剩下的纯股票类ETF只有华泰柏瑞沪深300ETF、华夏科创50ETF两只而已。钱在 ETF 里打转，没真正往个股里走。这也说明现在大部分在场内ETF里流转的资金，本质上还只是在ETF产品层面来回交易，并没有通过ETF的申赎环节真正流入到对应的一二级市场的个股里面，没有变成直接买股票的增量资金，今天指数被托住了。

W tym miesiącu firma Prime Medicine rozpoczęła u pierwszego pacjenta z chorobą Wilsona terapię opartą na edycji prime. 

Terapia odbywa się wprost w organizmie pacjenta. Nie pobiera się od niego komórek, żeby je edytować in vitro, a potem mu je wszczepiać (nie ma procedury ex vivo).

To pierwsze znane zastosowanie edycji prime in vivo u człowieka.

Badanie to faza 1/2 (NCT07748403), open-label, first-in-human.

Kwalifikowani są pacjenci z co najmniej jednym allelem H1069Q (planowana liczba uczestników to ok. 40-50). Wstępne dane spodziewane są w 2027 r.

According to Korean media, SK Hynix has started talks with its suppliers to mass produce iHBM, its new technology for pulling heat out of HBM.

Heat is one of the BIGGEST problems in AI memory because the more layers you stack and the faster you move data, the hotter the stack gets.

iHBM adds a cooling element on top of the base die, the chip at the bottom of the HBM stack that talks to the GPU.

SK Hynix says this cuts thermal resistance by more than 30%, which lets HBM run reliably under heavy loads.

The plan is to use it starting with HBM5 around 2029, and SK Hynix is already validating HBM5 on TSMC's CoWoS packaging.

Samsung and $MU are catching up fast in HBM, so SK Hynix is trying to win the next round on technology before it even starts.

That kind of race is great for $NVDA, because every new generation of HBM lets its GPUs do more work.
